sloka: सूतस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा वाचा परम दीनया ।बाष्प उपहतया राजा तम् सूतम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५९-१७॥
transliteration: sūtasya vacanam śrutvā vācā parama dīnayā ।bāṣpa upahatayā rājā tam sūtam idam abravīt ॥2-59-17॥

translations.english: The women, with their large, bright eyes flooded with gushing tears looked in silence at one another in deep anguish.
